_source: DOE prototype IDFs, docs/docs_VALIDATION/step1/Level 2 DOE round-trip/00.BaselineBuildings_NUs/ (ElevatorLift/Elevators ElectricEquipment or Exterior:FuelEquipment object + BLDG_ELEVATORS schedule, harvested verbatim via eppy fieldvalues)
_basis: single whole-building elevator lift motor object per prototype; design_level_w and prototype_floor_area_m2 always harvested from the SAME IDF instance so their ratio (density) is internally consistent even where a file is a regional/size variant (e.g. SecondarySchool 50pct_downscaled)
_heat_gain_default_note: Exterior:FuelEquipment prototypes (LargeOffice, LargeHotel, Hospital) carry no zone heat-gain split at all (exterior equipment). OpenUBEM emits the interior ElectricEquipment equivalent per PLAN Dependency decision and falls back to Fraction_Radiant=0.5/Latent=0/Lost=0 for these three only — this exact split is independently confirmed as the DOE-authored value on every ElectricEquipment-native archetype that has no other stated split (MediumOffice, SmallHotel, SecondarySchool, College), so it is not an invented default.
_omitted_findings: TallBuilding and SuperTallBuilding DOE prototypes (TallBuilding_90.1-2019_6A_Buffalo_v221.idf, SuperTallBuilding_90.1-2019_6A_Buffalo_v221.idf) were expected per PLAN §4 to carry a harvestable ElevatorLift object but do NOT: grep for ElevatorLift|Elevators_Equip returns zero matches in both files. They model elevator lobby/shaft zones as conditioned space with generic Watts/Area 'Elec Equip' plug loads (same density formula as every other zone, i.e. not an elevator-specific load) plus a dedicated 'Top_ElevatorMachineRm' HVAC zone (cooling only, no equipment object). No ElevatorLift design level exists in source for these two archetypes; they are correctly omitted per zero-fitted-params (T01 authoritative-list rule overrides the PLAN's illustrative table). RetailStandalone carries an unused orphan BLDG_ELEVATORS schedule (no object references it) — confirmed absent, correctly omitted. College was not in the PLAN's coverage list but its DOE prototype (College_90.1-2019_6A_Buffalo_v221.idf) does carry a real '2 Elevator Lift Motors' ElectricEquipment object (32110 W, subcategory 'Elevators'); included per the T01 comprehensive-harvest instruction ('for every DOE prototype IDF ... T01 produces the authoritative list').

HighriseApartment.prototype_floor_area_note: FULL-BUILDING area (7838 m2), NOT the reduced 3-zone-model area (2350.94 m2). The design_level_w (10597.39 W) is a whole-building elevator quantity, so it must be paired with the true full conditioned floor area to yield a correct W/m2 density; OpenUBEM production computes building area as footprint x ALL real floors (cooking._total_floor_area), matching this convention (cf. cooking_by_archetype.json pairing full-DOE areas). This prototype models only 3 representative levels at Zone Multiplier=1 (Z-origins 0 / 12.19 / 27.43 m at 3.048 m floor height => 10 physical floors); footprint = 2350.94/3 = 783.65 m2, x10 floors = 7836.5 m2, agreeing with the DOE-published 7838 m2 to 0.02%. Pure geometry, zero-fitted-params. CP-1 area correction 2026-07-14 per manager ruling.

MidriseApartment.prototype_floor_area_note: FULL-BUILDING area (3135 m2), NOT the reduced 3-zone-model area (2350.96 m2). Same rationale as HighriseApartment: the design_level_w (4360.9 W) is a whole-building quantity paired with the true full conditioned floor area. This prototype models 3 representative levels at Zone Multiplier=1 (Z-origins 0 / 3.048 / 9.144 m at 3.048 m floor height => 4 physical floors); footprint = 2350.96/3 = 783.65 m2, x4 floors = 3134.6 m2, agreeing with the DOE-published 3135 m2 to 0.01%. Pure geometry, zero-fitted-params. CP-1 area correction 2026-07-14 per manager ruling.

SecondarySchool.prototype_floor_area_note: DOWNSCALE PROVENANCE (not a bug — NO fix needed): both design_level_w (5896.595 W) and prototype_floor_area_m2 (9796.0 m2) were harvested from the SAME _50pct_downscaled source file, so the W/m2 density (design_level_w / prototype_floor_area_m2) is self-consistent and scale-invariant. Scaling a real full-size school by footprint x floors self-corrects; the absolute 9796 m2 deliberately differs from the RESULT_04 full-size 19592 m2 used by cooking_by_archetype.json but that difference is harmless because only the ratio matters. Flagged so this is not later mistaken for the apartment-style under-count bug.
